WEBVTT


00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:01.260
This is Turkey's new manager.

00:00:01.261 --> 00:00:02.781
A man from Ankara in black face

00:00:02.782 --> 00:00:05.221
is now the new manager of the Turkish football team.

00:00:05.222 --> 00:00:07.341
The UN and FIFA personally appointed him

00:00:07.342 --> 00:00:08.941
to lead Turkish team to victory.

00:00:08.942 --> 00:00:10.501
Nobody knows his training techniques,

00:00:10.502 --> 00:00:12.901
but it is rumored that he makes players dribble the ball

00:00:12.902 --> 00:00:14.221
while balancing a tray of T

00:00:14.222 --> 00:00:15.541
through a bizarre and stumble.

00:00:15.542 --> 00:00:18.501
Every failed pass is met with an uncle emerging from nowhere

00:00:18.502 --> 00:00:21.781
to explain why Turkish football peaked in 1566.

00:00:21.782 --> 00:00:25.021
Goalkeeper trains by catching watermelons thrown by a taxi driver

00:00:25.022 --> 00:00:27.181
who communicates exclusively through proverbs

00:00:27.182 --> 00:00:28.721
and aggressive hand gestures.

00:00:28.820 --> 00:00:30.700
For now considers them the favorite team.

00:00:30.701 --> 00:00:33.901
A Week 2, the squad has stopped using tactics boards entirely.

00:00:33.902 --> 00:00:36.141
They now consult a retired kebab shop owner

00:00:36.142 --> 00:00:37.741
known only as coach Mustafa.

00:00:37.742 --> 00:00:41.061
He predicts match outcomes by examining grill marks on lamb skewers.

00:00:41.062 --> 00:00:43.741
His record is somehow better than most football analysts.

00:00:43.742 --> 00:00:45.901
He is wearing a Baku athletics track suit.

00:00:45.902 --> 00:00:48.961
Get yours at childrenofkhan com link in bio.
